name: Qwen3-VL-Embedding
paper_title: Qwen3-VL-Embedding and Qwen3-VL-Reranker: A Unified Framework for State-of-the-Art Multimodal Retrieval and Ranking
license_interpretation: Apache-2.0 is a permissive license, so the Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B weights can be used in commercial and closed-source products. Redistributing them means keeping the license text and attribution notices, and the license grants a patent license. LibreYOLO copies no model source: the Qwen3-VL architecture runs through the Apache-2.0 Hugging Face Transformers implementation, and libreyolo/models/vlm/qwen3vl_embedding.py (MIT) adapts only the input conventions and last-token pooling of the reference embedder in QwenLM/Qwen3-VL-Embedding at commit 393e2978d27852b0d0230d6994f37f9c15bed73c (Apache-2.0, see libreyolo/models/vlm/NOTICE). The weights are a mirrored snapshot of Qwen/Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B at revision 9f2f7e710d6d81056aa5c0a4f04764fec6bb7bda, hosted at LibreYOLO/LibreQwen3VLEmbedding2b with learned parameters unchanged and not gated; the upstream Hugging Face repository ships no LICENSE file, so the mirror carries the Apache-2.0 text from the GitHub repository.
bibtex_verified: 2026-11-15, copied verbatim from the Citation section of the upstream README at commit 393e2978d27852b0d0230d6994f37f9c15bed73c. The Qwen/Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B model card at revision 9f2f7e710d6d81056aa5c0a4f04764fec6bb7bda publishes a variant that adds the arXiv number to the journal field but drops the comma in 'Chen, Keqin', so the GitHub entry is kept. Cross-checked against the arXiv API for 2601.04720: twelve authors in the same order, identical title, primary class cs.CL. Do not hand-edit; a wrong citation misattributes someone's work.
